result:
I renamed `billingUrl` to `billingEndpoint` (same value) and it's live. PR #1 on `mono` merged, and CI and CD both came back green.

- **Files changed:** `libs/shared-contracts/index.js` and the code in core-shell, sub-route-billing and sub-route-reports that read the setting. A grep finds no `billingUrl` left in the repo.
- **Start-up check:** I built all three apps locally before opening the PR, and each built cleanly. That is the only start-up check I ran. I didn't separately confirm the deployed apps start.
- **Other repos:** `platformkit` doesn't mention `billingUrl`, and the dependency catalog has no entry for it. So I changed only `mono` and bumped no library version. The billing app depends on `@studio/platform-kit` from the registry, but that library doesn't use this setting.
- **Surprises:** The first `st pr open --help` attempt errored because `st` has no help flag for subcommands. Running `st help` showed the right syntax. Nothing else slowed me down.

The ticket is marked done with `st done`.
